headline: Phone snatched outside San Pedro Square restaurant
body: SAN JOSE - A diner had her phone grabbed from an outdoor table at San Pedro Square around 9:30 p.m. on Friday, Oct. 3, 2025, police said. The suspect fled on foot toward St. John Street. The victim, 27-year-old Maria Delgado, was not injured. Police ask anyone with information to call the department's tip line.

headline: Woman reports being followed from San Pedro Square
body: SAN JOSE - A woman told police a man followed her for several blocks after she left a bar in San Pedro Square late Saturday night, Oct. 11, 2025. She said the man had also been watching her inside the bar earlier that evening. She ducked into a hotel lobby on Santa Clara Street and called a friend. Officer James Whitfield said no arrest has been made.

headline: Fight breaks out near San Pedro Square Market
body: SAN JOSE - Two men were treated for minor injuries after a fight broke out near the San Pedro Square Market entrance at about 1 a.m. Sunday, Oct. 19, 2025. Witnesses said the argument started inside a nearby bar and spilled onto the sidewalk. One man was cited for battery.

headline: Student harassed at St. James Park
body: SAN JOSE - An SJSU student reported being verbally harassed and blocked from leaving by a group of three people while cutting through St. James Park on the afternoon of Tuesday, Oct. 7, 2025. The student was able to walk away toward 1st Street. Campus police have shared the report with San Jose police.

headline: Bike stolen, rider shoved near St. James Park
body: SAN JOSE - A cyclist was pushed off his bike and the bike was taken near the northeast corner of St. James Park, at St. James and 3rd streets, shortly after 7 p.m. on Oct. 14, 2025. The rider, identified as Kevin Tran, 34, suffered scrapes. The suspect rode off toward Julian Street.

headline: Light rail rider reports unwanted touching
body: SAN JOSE - A woman reported that a man repeatedly touched her and made sexual comments while riding VTA light rail southbound on 2nd Street one evening last week. She got off at the Paseo de San Antonio area and reported it to a VTA fare inspector. VTA said it is reviewing onboard camera footage.

headline: Laptop taken from car near Diridon Station
body: SAN JOSE - A laptop and backpack were stolen from a parked car in a lot next to Diridon Station sometime Thursday morning, Oct. 16, 2025. The car's rear window was smashed. Police said vehicle break-ins near the station have been reported several times this month.

headline: Reports of man approaching people downtown
body: SAN JOSE - Several people have posted online about a man approaching pedestrians and demanding money somewhere in the downtown area over the past few weeks, mostly at night. Police said they have received a handful of calls but no specific location has been confirmed.

headline: King Library extends weekend hours for finals
body: SAN JOSE - Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Library will extend its weekend hours through the end of the fall semester to support students studying for finals, library director Susan Park announced. The library will stay open until midnight on Saturdays and Sundays starting Nov. 22.

headline: Paseo de San Antonio to host holiday art walk
body: SAN JOSE - Local artists will line the Paseo de San Antonio for a free holiday art walk on Saturday, Dec. 6, from noon to 6 p.m. Organizers expect food trucks, live music and family activities between the Convention Center and SJSU.

headline: Man grabs purse at St. James Park near N. 3rd Street
body: SAN JOSE - A woman's purse was grabbed from her shoulder at St. James Park near North 3rd Street at about 11:40 p.m. on Wednesday, Oct. 22, 2025, police said. The suspect ran north on 3rd Street. The woman was not hurt.

headline: Pedestrian punched at St. James Park
body: SAN JOSE - A man walking along the North 3rd Street edge of St. James Park was punched by a stranger shortly after midnight on Saturday, Oct. 25, 2025. He was treated at the scene for a bloody nose. Police said the attacker left on foot and has not been identified.

headline: Woman followed through St. James Park late at night
body: SAN JOSE - A woman reported that a man followed her from the light rail toward St. James Park and kept pace with her along North 3rd Street around 12:30 a.m. on Tuesday, Oct. 28, 2025. She called police from the corner of 3rd and St. James streets and the man walked away before officers arrived.

headline: Group harasses students at St. James Park and N. 3rd St.
body: SAN JOSE - Two SJSU students said a group of men shouted at them, made crude comments and tried to block their path at St. James Park near North 3rd Street at about 1 a.m. on Friday, Oct. 31, 2025. The students crossed the street and reported the incident to campus police.

headline: Phone stolen at Santa Clara light rail stop on 2nd Street
body: SAN JOSE - A rider's phone was snatched out of his hand while he waited at the Santa Clara Street light rail stop on 2nd Street at about 11:15 p.m. on Thursday, Oct. 23, 2025. VTA said the suspect ran east on Santa Clara Street.

headline: Woman harassed while waiting for light rail on 2nd St.
body: SAN JOSE - A woman told VTA staff that a man stood close to her, made sexual comments and refused to leave her alone at the light rail platform on 2nd Street at Santa Clara Street around midnight on Sunday, Oct. 26, 2025. VTA security escorted her onto the next train.

headline: Fight injures rider at 2nd and Santa Clara light rail stop
body: SAN JOSE - One person suffered minor injuries when an argument turned into a fight at the light rail stop on 2nd Street at Santa Clara Street at about 12:45 a.m. on Wednesday, Oct. 29, 2025. Police detained one man at the scene.

headline: Backpack taken at 1st Street light rail stop
body: SAN JOSE - A backpack containing a laptop was taken from a bench at the light rail stop on 1st Street at Santa Clara Street at around 11:50 p.m. on Monday, Nov. 3, 2025, while its owner was looking at the train schedule. Police are reviewing nearby camera footage.
